title: Mutate in Place
goal: Modify data inside a function using a mutable reference.
hints: The function add_suffix modifies s in place with .push_str().
To modify data through a reference, both the function parameter and the argument must use &mut.
explanation: &mut String creates an exclusive mutable reference, allowing add_suffix to modify msg in place without taking ownership. Using &String produces E0596 because shared references cannot be mutated. Passing msg by value without borrowing moves ownership into add_suffix, leaving msg in main invalid and causing E0382 if read later.
